gaps.description: GOAL_READING was set on 2025-08-18 with a 55% baseline, and the 2025 IEP says progress will be measured with comprehension probes and reported at least as often as report cards are issued. The 2026-03-16 IEP continues the goal and says classroom comprehension remains an instructional focus, but no supplied document reports any reading-comprehension probe result after the 55% baseline. The only progress report supplied covers the behavior goal. A reading progress report for 2025-08-18 to 2026-03-16 would answer this.
